SELECT REVIEW_NO reviewNo , MEMBER_NO memberNo , CREATOR_NO creatorNo , REVIEW_NAME reviewName , REVIEW_CONTENT reviewContent , REVIEW_DATE reviewDate , REVIEW_STATUS reviewStatus FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND REVIEW_STATUS = 'Y'
